name: framecore-works
description: FrameCore Works plugins for Claude Code and the Claude apps.

plugins.name: framecore-work-creative-studio
plugins.description: Creative direction and production planning for graphics, video, sound, stories, campaigns, copy, and prompts.

plugins.name: earshot-audio
plugins.description: Earshot by Leon Lin (github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot, MIT), packaged by FrameCore Works: ears and a sound kit for an agent: listen to, measure, choose and verify sound, render a film's effects on cue frames, and build soundtracks from licensed recordings. Local Earshot 0.4.0, no upload.

plugins.name: voice-narration
plugins.description: Voice-overs and narration from an approved script, measured against each scene's time: VoxCPM2 or Voicebox on the user's own computer, or ElevenLabs through the app's connector. Pronunciation lexicon per project, consent before cloning, a lock file for the mix.

plugins.name: brand-kit
plugins.description: A brand kit from a company website: colours, fonts, logo, imagery, tone of voice and messaging taken apart into Studio's brand kit format and a written brand audit, kept as numbered revisions per brand, then a plan for a new website, ads, Meta Ads, video or brand development handed to Studio's skills.

plugins.name: framecore-open-assets
plugins.description: Find free media through official keyless APIs with rights gates, verified downloads and source records.
